name: Dreams Royal Beach Punta Cana

kids_club.evidence: Explorer's Club (ages 3-12) is included and open 9am until 9:30 or 10pm (sources differ); children must be fully potty trained. Reports are positive but thin, and one family review says drop-off starts at 4.

water_play.evidence: Water park opened in January 2024 with a slide tower and racer slides, plus a splash pad with short slides and a tipping bucket for younger kids, open 10am-6pm. There are also two children's pools and a long lazy river.

beach.evidence: Wide, palm-lined Bávaro beach, described as calm and reef-protected, with seaweed fences and daily cleaning. Seaweed still shows up in the warmer months.

rooms.evidence: Deluxe rooms are about 570 sq ft with a king or two doubles. The Deluxe Family Room is two interconnecting units (about 1,140 sq ft) sleeping up to six.

food.evidence: About seven restaurants with no reservations needed, but 10-20 minute waits at peak dinner times, and reviewers call the lunch and dinner buffet mediocre and the à la carte line-up unremarkable. Guests from Secrets Royal Beach on the same complex can also use Dreams' restaurants.

condition.evidence: Formerly Now Larimar, it was renovated in 2020-21 (lobby, pools, buffet, bars) and gained the water park in 2024. Some recent reviews say rooms need updating (broken furniture, leaking showers).

kids_club.name: Explorer's Club
kids_club.notes: Must be potty trained. Core Zone teen club (13-17) runs mid-afternoon to midnight. Shares a complex with adults-only Secrets Royal Beach, which shares the spa, gym and casino; Secrets guests can use Dreams venues but not the reverse.

pros: The 2024 water park has a splash pad with small slides for younger kids, plus two kids' pools
Family Rooms are two connected units, and standard rooms come with two doubles
Calm, wide Bávaro beach with seaweed fences
cons: The food is the weak spot: buffet dinners and à la carte variety get lukewarm reviews
Secrets Royal Beach guests share the Dreams restaurants and pools, adding to the crowds
Some rooms reported as worn despite the 2020-21 renovation
Kids' club hours and minimum drop-off age are inconsistent across sources (check whether drop-off starts at 3 or 4)
verdict: A very good all-round match, with a short transfer, calm beach, new splash pad and connecting family rooms, if families can live with average food.
